content_html:
Do you want to enjoy a spectacular landscape without having to share it with hundreds of people? then Palcoyo It is the perfect option for you. This impressive mountain of colors, located in the Cusco region, is the ideal alternative to the famous Mountain of 7 Colors (Vinicunca). It offers views just as magical, but with an easier and fewer tourists.

What is Palcoyo?

Palcoyo is a chain of mountains dyed with natural colors due to the minerals that make them up. Unlike Vinicunca, where you must walk more than 6 kilometers at high altitude, In Palcoyo you only walk about 1 kilometer, making it ideal for people of all ages.

Why choose Palcoyo instead of Vinicunca?

  • Less physical effort: The walk is short and gradual.
  • Few crowds: You will be able to take photos without waiting for turns or dealing with large groups.
  • Unique landscape: In addition to the colorful mountains, you will also be able to see a stone forest and panoramic views of the Andes.
  • Ideal for the whole family: Perfect for travelers with children or older adults.

How to get to Palcoyo from Cusco?

Palcoyo is located about 3 and a half hours by car from Cusco. Most tours leave early in the morning (between 5:30 and 6:00 a.m.) and return in the afternoon. The route includes a stop for breakfast and another for lunch in local towns.

Altitude and climate

The average altitude is 4,900 m.a.s.l., so we recommend you acclimatize in Cusco at least one or two days before. Bring warm clothing, sunscreen and water.

When is the best time to visit Palcoyo?

The best time is between April and October, during the dry season. During these months, the sky is usually clear and the colors of the mountains are seen with greater intensity.

Useful tips for your visit

  • Carry cash in soles for small purchases or tickets.
  • Wear comfortable, waterproof shoes.
  • If you are sensitive to altitude, consider bringing soroche pills or consult your doctor.
  • Don't forget your camera or cell phone with a good battery: you'll want to capture every moment!
